title: 第1章 开局矿奴激活简化系统第2章 黑狼拳入门
slug: 开局黑狼拳简化后让我学狼叫
content_zh:
“草！”
暗无天日的矿洞内，赵寒暗骂一声，挥舞着手中的铁锹，狠狠挖着矿洞。
这里是大周国西北凉州的黑水县。
黑水县有两大帮派，毒蛇帮和黑狼帮。
毒蛇帮在县城外有个精铁矿洞，矿洞内有几百号到处抓来的矿奴正在挖矿。
这些矿奴，一分工钱都没有，全都是被毒蛇帮的帮众敲闷棍抓来打黑工的。
从凌晨四点天还不见亮就开始干活，一直要干到晚上七点夜幕。
足足15个小时，除了午饭和晚饭，一直无休，哪怕喝口水都不行。
监管几百号矿奴的监工，只有二十名手持兵器的毒蛇帮精锐帮众。
二十人监管几百号人，靠的是超绝的武力！
这二十人全是武者！
武者有炼体一说，分为炼皮境、炼肉境、炼骨境、炼脏境、炼血境。
这二十人，便清一色的都是炼皮境武者！
何为炼皮，便是将体表皮肤，练得和牛皮一样坚硬，达到普通拳脚难伤的地步。
炼皮层次越深，这牛皮也就越硬越坚韧，也就越能挨打。
乃至于普通的刀剑对他们效果都不大。
这也是为何二十人，手持兵器就能管理数百人。
“给我狠狠干，只要干不死，就往死里干！”
“吃得苦中苦，方为人上人，你们只要好好挖矿，总有出头之日的一天！”
“乱世当头，外面人吃人，皆为两脚羊，唯有我毒蛇帮给你们一口饭吃，你们要记得感恩、团结、忠诚！”

“这是我毒蛇帮给你们的福报，只要谁能坚持干满两年半，就有机会提拔为普通帮众！”
一群监工不断来回走动监管，嘴里还时不时说着一些激励的话。
说完后，监工就不知道跑哪里去摸鱼了。
矿奴们麻木挖矿，哪有人会相信这些狗屁鸡汤。
被抓来挖矿的，几乎没有活过一年的。
大部分结局都是累死，要么就是矿洞坍塌被砸死。
或是干活不努力被殴打致死，乃至于病死。
矿奴们虽然不满这些监工，但无可奈何，还是得继续挖，生活还得过下去。
和监工说的一样，外面正值天下大乱，王侯将相宁有种乎这种类似的宣言，到处都在传播。
盛世之下，妖魔潜藏；乱世之下，亦有大妖诡怪兴风作浪。
待在暗无天日的矿洞，无论如何也有口饭吃。
人身安全也能得到保障，比外面人吃人、妖怪吃人的环境强的多。
赵寒见到监工走远，稍微歇息了一下放松了动作，嘴里暗骂道：
“一群周扒皮，说的和唱的一样好听。”
赵寒，男，18岁！
前世是个蓝星刚毕业就失业的社畜。
content_en:
"Grass!"
In the dark mine, Zhao Han cursed secretly, waved the shovel in his hand, and dug hard into the mine.
This is Heishui County in Liangzhou, northwest of the Great Zhou Kingdom.
There are two major gangs in Blackwater County, the Viper Gang and the Black Wolf Gang.
The Viper Gang has a fine iron mine outside the county town. In the mine, there are hundreds of mining slaves captured from everywhere, mining.
These mine slaves didn't get a penny of wages. They were all beaten by the Viper Gang and used to work illegally.
I started working at four o'clock in the morning before dawn, and continued until nightfall at seven o'clock in the evening.
A full 15 hours, except for lunch and dinner, there was no break, not even for a drink of water.
The overseers who oversee hundreds of mine slaves only have twenty elite members of the Viper Gang armed with weapons.
Twenty people supervise hundreds of people, relying on superb force!
These twenty people are all warriors!
Warriors have a theory of body refining, which is divided into skin refining realm, meat refining realm, bone refining realm, organ refining realm, and blood refining realm.
These twenty people are all skin refining realm warriors!
What is skin refining? It is to train the skin on the body surface to be as hard as cowhide, to the point where it is difficult to be injured by ordinary fists and feet.
The deeper the level of leather refining, the harder and tougher the leather becomes, and the more it can withstand beatings.
Even ordinary swords have little effect on them.
This is why twenty people, armed with weapons, can manage hundreds of people.
"Fuck me hard. If you can't do it to death, then do it to death!"
"You can only become a master by enduring hardships. As long as you work hard, you will be successful one day!"
"In troubled times, people outside are eating people, and they are all sheep with two legs. Only I, the Viper Gang, can give you a bite to eat. You must remember to be grateful, united, and loyal!"
"This is a blessing from our Viper Gang. Anyone who can persist in working for two and a half years will have the opportunity to be promoted to an ordinary gang member!"
A group of supervisors kept walking back and forth to supervise, and they also said some encouraging words from time to time.
After saying that, the supervisor didn't know where to go to catch fish.
The mining slaves are mining numbly, no one will believe this bullshit.
Almost none of those captured for mining survived more than a year.
Most of the endings are death from exhaustion or being crushed to death when the mine collapses.
Or they were beaten to death for not working hard, or even died of illness.
Although the mine slaves were dissatisfied with these overseers, they had no choice but to continue digging and live their lives.
Just like what the supervisor said, the world is in chaos outside, and similar declarations like this are being spread everywhere.
In prosperous times, monsters lurk; in troubled times, there are also big monsters making trouble.
Staying in a dark mine, you can still have something to eat no matter what.
Personal safety can also be guaranteed, which is much better than the environment outside where people eat people and monsters eat people.
When Zhao Han saw the supervisor walking away, he took a short rest and relaxed his movements, and cursed secretly:
"A group of Zhou Bapi, what they say is as good as what they sing."
Zhao Han, male, 18 years old!
In his previous life, he was a social worker who lost his job right after graduating from Blue Star.
